# bradhill.dev

Personal site for Brad Hill, AI & Agentic Engineer (Melbourne): ventures in AI and agentic engineering,
each told as the idea, the solution, the outcome and the learnings.

**Do not edit the HTML here.** It is generated by `E:/beyond-typical/portfolio-site/build.mjs --public`
from `ventures.mjs`, with charts drawn from real data at build time; copy its `dist/` in to deploy.

Static, no build step on the host. GitHub Pages with the custom domain `bradhill.dev` (see `CNAME`),
DNS on Cloudflare.

The previous site is preserved at tag `legacy-2026-07` and branch `legacy-2026-07-site`.
